senses.sense_definition: A recurring theme, subject, or idea throughout a work of literature, art, or someone's life.

examples.text: The struggle between individual freedom and social expectation is a recurring <w>leitmotif</w> in her novels.
A distinct <w>leitmotif</w> of suspicion ran through all his political speeches.

senses.sense_definition: A short, recurring musical phrase associated with a particular person, place, or idea, especially in an opera.

examples.text: Whenever the villain appeared on screen, the orchestra played a sinister <w>leitmotif</w>.
The composer assigned a delicate <w>leitmotif</w> to represent the hero's lost homeland.
